Youthful streetwear ad, two shots, consistent characters and palette throughout.

Shot 1 (wide): @Subject1, the young man in a white sweatshirt, black joggers, yellow-orange socks and chunky white sneakers with transparent bubble soles, strides along a neon-lit wall glowing green-to-cyan at night, collar headphones on, walking with rhythm as the neon light washes over him. Low-angle tracking shot.

Shot 2 (medium): Fast cut. @Subject2, the girl with long cyan hair, tie-dye tee, tiger-striped and slime-green sleeves, fuzzy orange gloves, rides her BMX with cow-print handlebars around the corner and glides to a stop beside @Subject1. She hops off, they both look down at his sneakers, and the bubble soles flash once in the neon light as they step forward together. Camera pulls back into a wide two-shot under the neon glow.

Upbeat funk-pop track with claps, bike freewheel clicking in Shot 2, sneakers squeaking on pavement, one deep bass hit when they land together. Youthful energetic street-ad mood, consistent green-cyan neon palette across shots.这个提示词里面，角色一跟角色二的这个，嗯
